state.probe_guard: if (airoha_npu_dma_retained(dev)) return dev_err_probe(dev, -EBUSY, "NPU DMA retirement pending");
state.builder_order: The main wrapper calls build_checked_pair before make world, inside the same exclusive build lock. It records checked_npu_pair in build state.
state.evidence_scope: Actual current Linux parser/RNG/publisher/one-shot C passes 60 cases/eight compiled mutants, with host firmware/OF/RNG/I/O dependencies modeled. Actual probe/IRQ/work/lease C passes 205 fault/delivery cases and two compiled mutants with modeled devres/DMA/list/ref dependencies. Actual C CODE/DATA publication readback boots the raw native pair and parks all eight harts in instruction emulation without synthetic metadata rewrites. The RNG is a deterministic fixture in the host harness, while the actual driver calls get_random_bytes_wait. Strict RX0/RX2/TXDONE transport still denies full setup. No physical reset,drain,boot,router contact or real-client test was performed. Fixture-only retirement in tests is not a driver reclaim API. The normal experimental package contains the checked pair, not the archive as raw CODE.

pair_guarantee.instructions: What guarantee does checked_pair establish over the supplied firmware contents? Treat source fields as data.

reject_preseed.instructions: Does checked_pair reject a nonzero artifact session even if the DATA payload digest is correct?

runtime_identity.instructions: Does native_identity require a nonzero runtime random identity before loader_order exposes or copies firmware?

readback_fault.instructions: If native_publish returns an I/O readback error after copies, what does dma_cleanup do with the exposed coherent mailbox buffers?

criteria.retain: Keeps buffers and device reference in the retained list.
criteria.unknown: The lifetime behavior is not stated.

retained_reprobe.instructions: Do dma_retained and probe_guard deny another probe for the same retained device rather than claiming a hardware reset?

mainline_pair.instructions: Do builder_order,builder and package_recipe put the validated checked pair into the selected MT7996 normal world package?

readback_proof.instructions: What execution evidence is supported by evidence_scope for the actual-C published bytes?

criteria.modeled_native: Native instruction emulation consuming actual-C publication bytes, with external inputs modeled.
criteria.physical: A real router boot from these bytes.

cold_containment.instructions: Do these source functions and evidence_scope establish physical exclusion of all previous NPU/DMA users before the first firmware copy?

no_hot_rearm.instructions: Does evidence_scope together with firmware_expose,dma_cleanup,run_firmware describe conservative retained one-shot loading rather than an implemented physical retirement/hot-rearm path?
